content:
Analyze the visual quality of a browser FPS game (DOOM clone) from these screenshots and give concrete frontend/design improvement recommendations.

Screenshots (view them with your vision capability):
- /tmp/opencode/pos-corredor.png — corridor with gun viewmodel + HUD
- /tmp/opencode/pos-arena.png — arena with enemies (imps with horns/glowing eyes)
- /tmp/opencode/pos-pickups.png — health/armor/weapon pickups area

Report:
1. What is visible in each shot (walls, floor, ceiling, HUD elements, weapon, enemies, pickups)
2. Visual quality assessment: lighting, textures, color palette, contrast, readability
3. Specific flaws (flat areas, ugly elements, poor contrast, weak HUD)
4. Prioritized frontend/design improvements, grouped:
   - HUD/UI (health bar, ammo, crosshair, weapon indicator, minimap)
   - World visuals (textures, lighting, fog, atmosphere)
   - Game feel (viewmodel placement, weapon animation, hit feedback)
5. Score each screenshot 0.0000001-100 (scale where nothing is perfect, 100 unattainable) with concrete bugs noted

Be concrete and technical.
